reading.rtitle: How to Get to the Camp
paras: Here is how you come to the camp every morning. The sports center is on Grand Avenue, near the public library.
Take the bus number twelve at the corner of Fifth Street. The bus stops in front of the library. The trip takes about twenty minutes.
One ticket costs two dollars. You can buy your ticket on the bus, but you need coins. The driver doesn't give change.
Do you need help? If you are lost, call this number: five five five, zero one four two. Don't walk to the camp -- it is very far.

listenings.text: Good morning. This is the bus number twelve to Grand Avenue. Our next stop is Fifth Street. Please have your ticket ready. One ticket is two dollars and we only take coins. After Fifth Street we stop at the public library, and then at the city sports center. The bus doesn't stop at the park today because the street is closed. If you need help, please talk to me. Thank you.

Hi Bruno, this is Coach Parker. Where are you? The practice starts in ten minutes. Listen: when you leave the bus, you see a big blue building. That is the library. Don't go left. Go right, and walk two minutes. The sports center is on your left, next to a small coffee shop. Who is with you? If you are alone, call me and I go to the door. See you in a minute.

extra_audio.text: Bruno waits for the bus at the corner of Fifth Street. He asks a woman where the bus stops. He buys a ticket with two coins. He leaves the bus in front of the library. He asks a man where the sports center is.
